dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave curvature between the apex and the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse geometric classification and a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin with a linear slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured ratio of approximately 0.95:1 for maximum base width relative to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged notches along the dorsal ridge posterior to the fin. Multiple small nicks on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin and several pale depigmented lesions on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced saw-tooth deformity of the dorsal ridge.
